modules.name: Notification
modules.evidence: owner-scoped durable notification facts + monotonic change stream/read state + App quota/idempotency receipts (ADR-0014; Core migrations 029 and forward-only CREATED-revision hardening 031; reliability publication migration 030): Core producers join source transactions through a neutral tx-scoped sink, while PostgreSQL transaction locks arbitrate genuinely concurrent first producer/read/App requests. Snapshot page, unread count and owner-counter watermark share one repeatable-read view; continuation tokens retain the first-page watermark across concurrent inserts, sweep cannot regress it, and unread snapshots expose their positive CREATED revision (real-PostgreSQL regression evidence). Reliability incident facts arrive at-least-once over the versioned private claim/complete RPC; the live consumer probe starts/degrades fail-closed and bounded source calls recover/drain backlog, while make test-incident-notifications proves the software chain but not rootless supervisor acceptance. Gateway exposes exactly the public NotificationService with resumable bounded watch, heartbeat, per-owner budget, sweep-gap RESET_REQUIRED, pre-decode budget, dynamic device-session identity and bounded mid-stream revalidation. Desktop keeps only the latest 100 discardable in-memory facts, prevents stale refresh/revision rollback, and typed actions distinguish authoritative NotFound from transient failure. make test-notification-center proves live delivery, typed action and Gateway/Core restart catch-up; make test-lan-pairing additionally pairs two independent Chromium persistent profiles through the production TLS/session gate and proves notification arrival plus READ-only cross-device convergence. Granted-app notifications.create is negotiated from the exact grant epoch; Core locks Project/installation and reauthorizes before every replay, then atomically adjudicates idempotency/quota/projection, so uninstall/revoke and concurrent first quota requests fail closed without side effects (make test-app-notifications over an opaque-origin web bundle).
